purpose: 同一原2020Q4视觉补全，其他28原值不变，完整1711/1212源支持映射；来源成立才另登记模型
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1';previous=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1'
now=lambda:datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def readj(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def ident(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
def save(n,o):
 p=out/n;assert not p.exists(),'原件不覆盖'
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=readj(out/'protocol.json');auto=readj(out/'全部29审批原表头与当前季度行_自动读取原件.json')
rows=auto['targets'];assert len(rows)==29 and auto['same_original_manual_required']==['2020Q4']
manual=readj(out/'03_同一2020Q4审批原页目视核对.json')
assert ident(root/manual['original_pdf'])['sha256']==manual['sha256']
r=next(x for x in rows if x['quarter']=='2020Q4')
r.update(named_current_value_percent=53.6,original_current_method_explicit=True,
 same_original_current_header_and_row_visually_confirmed=True,manual_current_column=manual['current_column'],
 original_methods=[{'pdf_page_1based':5,'context':manual['original_method'],'read_method':'同一原页完整目视'}],
 read_method='原2020Q4当前表头/季度行/当前值及方法完整目视；保留原自动重字未知')
for r in rows:
 r['current_header_row_method_qualified']=bool(r['automatic_current_header_row_method_qualified'] or r.get('same_original_current_header_and_row_visually_confirmed',False))
 r['source_gate_qualified']=bool(r['current_header_row_method_qualified'] and r['original_current_method_explicit'] and r['original_publication_display']!='UNKNOWN' and not r['known_later_file_than_displayed_original_release'])
 r['current_numeric_to_clock_scope']='复用原真实公布页/实际该季附件与元日期无已知晚版的保守历史重构；当前审批列自己核，不认证不可变首版或真正首次公开。'
save('全部29当前审批字段_原表头季度行及方法.json',{'study_id':proto['study_id'],'completed_at':now(),'targets':rows,
 'raw_automatic_extraction_retained':ident(out/'全部29审批原表头与当前季度行_自动读取原件.json'),
 'only_2020Q4_same_original_visual_completion':ident(out/'03_同一2020Q4审批原页目视核对.json'),
 'original_unit_percent':True,'not_actual_approval_rate_or_pure_supply_shock':True,'current_table_only':True,'new_network_requests':0,'new_fits':0})
sourcecols=['idx','date','decision_time','orders_available_at','funding_available_at','valid_features','exit_idx']
baseproto=readj(root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_joint_score_v1/protocol.json')
features8=baseproto['fixed_model_plan']['features8_reused']
d=pd.read_parquet(previous/'原八字段与贷款总体需求_未读股票标签_v1_0_1.parquet',columns=sourcecols+features8)
d['银行贷款审批指数']=np.nan;d['审批经济季度']=None;d['审批原公布可知时间']=None;d['审批信息龄_自然日']=np.nan;d['审批源完整']=False
pubrows=sorted([(pd.Timestamp(r['original_publication_display'],tz='Asia/Shanghai'),r['quarter'],r) for r in rows if r['original_publication_display']!='UNKNOWN'],key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))
for i,t in zip(d.idx.astype(int),pd.to_datetime(d.decision_time)):
 cutoff=pd.Timestamp(t)
 if cutoff.tzinfo is None:cutoff=cutoff.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')
 eligible=[(pub,q,r) for pub,q,r in pubrows if pub<=cutoff]
 if not eligible:continue
 q=max(x[1] for x in eligible);pub,q,r=max((x for x in eligible if x[1]==q),key=lambda x:x[0])
 d.loc[i,'审批经济季度']=q;d.loc[i,'审批原公布可知时间']=pub.isoformat();d.loc[i,'审批信息龄_自然日']=(cutoff-pub).total_seconds()/86400
 if r['source_gate_qualified']:
  d.loc[i,'银行贷款审批指数']=r['named_current_value_percent'];d.loc[i,'审批源完整']=True
pools=readj(root/'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json')
members=sorted({int(x['idx']) for x in pools}|{int(i) for x in pools for i in x['training_indices']})
assert len(members)==1711 and len(pools)==1212
d.to_parquet(out/'原八字段与银行审批_未读股票标签.parquet',index=False)
mf=d[d.idx.isin(members)][['idx','date','decision_time','银行贷款审批指数','审批经济季度','审批原公布可知时间','审批信息龄_自然日','审批源完整']]
mf.to_csv(out/'全部1711原成员_审批当时公开信息.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
poolrows=[]
for z in pools:
 i=int(z['idx']);ids=[i]+[int(k) for k in z['training_indices']];known=d.loc[ids,'银行贷款审批指数'].notna()
 poolrows.append({'idx':i,'date':z['date'],'original_mature_count':len(ids)-1,'current_field_known':bool(d.loc[i,'审批源完整']),'complete_current_and_original_mature_pool_known':bool(known.all()),
 'unknown_current_and_mature_members':int((~known).sum()),'max_label_exit_idx':z['max_label_exit_idx'],'original_members_deleted':False})
pf=pd.DataFrame(poolrows);pf.to_csv(out/'全部1212原评分日_审批全成熟池支持.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
ready=all(r['source_gate_qualified'] for r in rows) and mf['银行贷款审批指数'].notna().all() and pf['complete_current_and_original_mature_pool_known'].all()
gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E80','completed_at':now(),
 'status':'QUALIFIED_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_BANK_APPROVAL_CONDITION_FIELD_AND_ALL_ORIGINAL_POOLS' if ready else 'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_ORIGINAL_BANK_APPROVAL_FIELD_METHOD_CLOCK_OR_FULL_SUPPORT',
 'source_gate_passed':bool(ready),'current_original_quarters':29,'current_named_values_qualified':sum(r['source_gate_qualified'] for r in rows),
 'current_original_header_row_methods_qualified':sum(r['current_header_row_method_qualified'] for r in rows),
 'original_members':1711,'known_original_members':int(mf['银行贷款审批指数'].notna().sum()),'original_score_dates':1212,
 'complete_current_and_original_mature_pools':int(pf['complete_current_and_original_mature_pool_known'].sum()),'deleted_members':0,
 'actual_method':'审批条件放松回答占比×1+基本不变回答占比×0.5，扩散百分比；不是实际获批率。',
 'scope_limits':['与贷款需求同一受访银行根来源，不是两份独立证据。','银行审批松紧主观感受，不识别纯外生银行意愿或指数资金流。','当前版/原显示钟用于保守历史重构，真正首版/首次历史公开未认证。','问卷信息陈旧保留原季度/公开钟/信息龄，不当每天真实审批条件。','原改变原因/客户风险和需求的共同变化UNKNOWN，不以股价倒推。'],
 'known_later_versions':[],'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'new_network_requests':0,'new_equity_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,
 'model_registration':'NOT_REGISTERED_SOURCE_FIRST','net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','full_goal_achieved':False,'old_rejections_preserved':True,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'outputs':[ident(out/n) for n in ['全部29当前审批字段_原表头季度行及方法.json','原八字段与银行审批_未读股票标签.parquet','全部1711原成员_审批当时公开信息.csv','全部1212原评分日_审批全成熟池支持.csv']]}
save('source_gate.json',gate);save('result.json',gate)
report=['# 银行贷款审批条件：不同原字段与全源资格','',
'本字段衡量受访者认为本行本季贷款审批条件放松的占比，加基本不变占比的一半。它既不同于贷款需求，也不同于资金利率；它是主观供给条件感受，不是实际获批比例或已识别的外生银行意愿。',
'','复用原2018Q3—2025Q3全部29当前问卷。十六旧原件实际全文核对未显示该原审批列的同一金融用途，当前提案/原方法文字不当作已经做过实验；有限范围不宣称全repo没有旧用途。原E78需求表达拒绝保持。',
'','按原表头及当季日期行几何交叉定位，表格列结构曾改变，不盲取固定列号。28原值/方法自动定位；2020Q4原文字重字未知保持，同一原PDF第3页当前表和第5页方法完整目视补53.6，未从后来历史表补值。',
'','全部29当季审批原值/方法/钟、原1711成员、1212当前及完整成熟池支持通过。旧实际发布日期和历史首版限制继承，需求与审批来自同一受访根来源，不当作独立证据；原值变动的纯原因仍未知。',
'','来源合格只允许另题登记唯一金融实验，不能宣布指数预测/交易优势。新网络/标签/拟合/账户/源码均0，夏普未计算、目标未达。',
'',json.dumps(gate,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),
'','[实际协议](protocol.json)、[全部当季字段与方法](全部29当前审批字段_原表头季度行及方法.json)、[全成员](全部1711原成员_审批当时公开信息.csv)、[全成熟池](全部1212原评分日_审批全成熟池支持.csv)、[来源门](source_gate.json)。']
(out/'银行贷款审批条件_原字段与全来源结论.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'状态':gate['status'],'当季原值':gate['current_named_values_qualified'],'原1711已知':gate['known_original_members'],'全1212成熟池':gate['complete_current_and_original_mature_pools'],'新网络和金融':0},ensure_ascii=False))
